nom: IT Cosmetics Hello Sunshine Invisible Sunscreen For Face SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most often report the sunscreen does not work well for them: it stays greasy, crumbles under makeup or gets shinier through the day, and some explicitly do not recommend it for oily skin.
segments.dry: Most reviewers with dry skin report it hydrates well and does not dry out even flaky or extra-dry patches, though one reviewer with dry skin found it sat on top of her skin, stayed greasy and never set.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including sensitive and red-prone skin, report no irritation and even a calming effect, though one reviewer with sensitive skin reports it broke her out on the chin.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin in a dry climate reports it feels good and leaves no white cast.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and call the formula non-comedogenic even on acne-prone or sensitive skin, but two reviewers describe breakouts: one with a severe heat-rash-like reaction and one with an isolated chin breakout despite the product working elsewhere on her sensitive skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin are the most likely to be disappointed, several reporting it stays greasy, crumbles under makeup or gets shinier over the day and do not recommend it for oily skin; one reviewer, by contrast, says it helped control her oiliness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, red-prone skin reports the formula calms her redness, while another reviewer without normally sensitive skin describes a severe heat-rash-like reaction with visible hives.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report strong, lasting hydration that holds up even on extra-dry or flaky patches, though one reviewer with dry skin found it never fully absorbed and left her skin sitting greasy on top.
concerns.aging: One reviewer reports the formula unexpectedly plumped the look of her fine lines.
concerns.spots: One reviewer who freckles easily reports the sunscreen keeps new freckles from forming when worn daily.

aspects.libelle: Doubles as sunscreen, primer and hydrating serum
No white cast, even on deep skin tones
Runny formula, easy to dispense too much
Fragrance too strong or unpleasant for some

extraits.texte: I don't have sensitive skin and usually use the Ordinary, urban rx and good molecule but was referred by ulta lady to get this instead of the ordinary sunscreen and terrible mistake. I broke out so bad with small heat rash all over my face. It looks so bad and looks like hives. Totally would not recommend.
super oily and does not accept any type of makeup on top. It crumbles and becomes more oily during the day.

I really wanted to love this product and gave it several tries before writing this review. I adore the high SPF and primer in one aspect. I couldn't get past the fragrance; to me it was not pleasant and it lingered. It was also SO greasy on my face!! I have dry skin and this just seemed to sit on top of my skin and did nothing. Believe me, I tried everything over several days to get it to set. No go for me.

This sunscreen feels really nice when I apply it, it soaks in nice without making me look oily and leaves my skin pretty soft. It doesn't pill, which is awesome! I found as an actual primer it didn't do much for me, but maybe that is user error. My biggest complaint is that it makes me breakout on my chin, but I have sensitive skin and am yet to find sunscreen that works perfectly on my face.

I put this on 3x daily. A lot of people don't realize that wearing sunscreen everday isnt only for sun protection. its for hydration. And holy cow. This stuff is perfect. I have very dry skin, but not anymore. This stuff saved my face. I wash my face AM and PM. Put on toner, brightening serum and hello sunshine in the AM. Mid/late afternoon, i rinse my face, sprtiz on toner then reapply hello sunshine. PM i wash my face, toner, brightening serum, estee lauder under eye, estee lauder face moisturizer, and again, hello sunshine. Sometimes i apply hello sunshine 4x daily, if face is feel crisp, but im telling you. If i wasnt so anal about face care, this would be a stand alone product. Worth the $$.
